experiment: V21-CLC: closed-loop grounding-to-action error correction inside the existing SafeDiff-VLA V21 pipeline (final four-task refinement; extension of freeze3 V21-PIC; Randomized-domain adaptation). No new network, no retraining: every checkpoint equals freeze3 (verified by hash at freeze time).
runner: scripts/run_final4.sh clc -> freeze4/selected_env.sh -> scripts/run_clc.sh -> scripts/clc_rt_policy.py (versioned copy of the frozen pic_rt_policy.py; all CLC_* options default off)

handover_block.what: pre-grasp chunk executed through an aligned lead-in point, the standoff point and a straight final approach along the gripper finger axis (samples 9,19,29,34,39,44,49 instead of every 10th); commanded-vs-measured check at the standoff (repeat once if > 1 cm)

place_container_plate.what: same approach; grounding cross-checks (confidence gate, low-threshold re-proposal) of the existing executor enabled for this single-arm task; grounded fallback (coarse head estimate + mean training-domain grasp offset clc_stats.json) when two-view grounding fails; after release the referent is re-grounded and a bounded retry (ACL_RETRY) is triggered when it is confidently seen > 10 cm from the gripper

selected_config.stack_blocks_two: unchanged freeze3 configuration (regression control; stage-conditioned subgoal scorer subgoal_s2 + acl_p2 preserved)

common.ACL_TRACE: off (no privileged logging in the final)

not_adopted_on_dev_evidence: CLC_NEAR close-range lateral correction for handover (with return pose: 31/60 Rand, 50/60 Clean vs 32/60, 53/60 without; first version without return pose 6/20, 13/20)
CLC_ASSOC + CLC_RECENTER prior-consistent wrist association / re-centred views (no grounding-accuracy gain; Clean 16/20 vs 19/20)
CLC_APPROACH=1 (standoff sample only: 9/20, 15/20 vs 11/20, 19/20 for the aligned lead-in)
place_container_plate without grounding cross-checks: pcp2 29/60 Rand; verify-only pcpV 32/60 Rand, 50/60 Clean (Clean +4 over freeze3 is within noise; Randomized is the priority, pcp3 selected)
CLC_APPROACH=2 for stack_blocks_two: Randomized gain comes from one block only (+1, -2, +9); the frozen successful configuration is kept as instructed
CLC_RECVXY (untested: receive stage succeeded 9/9 once the approach was fixed)
selection: development seeds only (blocks D 7200300+/7500300+, E 7200400+/7500400+, F 7200500+/7500500+); offset statistics clc_stats.json from training-domain rollouts (seeds < 7000000, incl. 5300900+/5350900+)
privileged_information: simulator object states are logged only with ACL_TRACE=1 for offline diagnostics; never a policy input; trace is off in the final
